title: 12-apps: voluntary member self-leave from groups (18.8.2)
description: spec/12-apps.md 18.8.2 'Leaving a Group': a member voluntarily leaves via DELETE on their own node, removing group + key material. Current DELETE /groups/{gid} is owner-only authoritative delete (groups_collection.py:713-731); ordinary members receive 4.03 and have no self-leave path. Add member self-leave (DELETE own membership, wipe local key material) distinct from owner delete. See docs/spec-coverage/12-apps.md R-12-064.
